Format Description: First-person, intimate camera angles where a creator completes a physical task (e.g., skincare, dressing) while telling a story.
LLM Evaluation Target: Can the model detect the parallel timelines? (The visual progression of makeup/outfits vs. the audio of a completely unrelated story).

Format Description: High-density talking-head video. Usually shot closely in portrait mode, relying heavily on emotional facial expressions, rapid cuts, and auto-generated captions.
LLM Evaluation Target: Detecting tone, sarcasm, micro-expressions, and matching spoken words to fast-scrolling text.

Format Description: Acting out a scenario from the perspective of the viewer or a specific character, often utilizing on-screen text to set the premise (e.g., "POV: You are the last slice of pizza").
LLM Evaluation Target: Spatial and relational understanding. Does the model identify that the camera is representing a specific entity rather than a passive observer?

Format Description: The creator’s face or cutout is overlaid onto a background image, article, or another video using the "greenscreen" effect.
LLM Evaluation Target: Segmenting foreground (the speaker) from background (the content being discussed) and tracking where the speaker is gesturing.

Format Description: Stock footage, motion graphics, or simple loops layered with text-to-speech (TTS) audio and captions explaining a concept.
LLM Evaluation Target: Assessing if the visual elements are contextually relevant to the voiceover or just arbitrary placeholder graphics.

Format Description: Screen grabs of forums, text messages, or notes apps with a synthetic voice reading the dialogue aloud over background gameplay (like Minecraft or Subway Surfers).
LLM Evaluation Target: Multi-stream OCR tracking. Can the model read static text while ignoring the fast-paced, irrelevant background gameplay?

Format Description: Fast-cut instructional videos showing the hands-only preparation of food, crafts, or assembly.
LLM Evaluation Target: Temporal ordering and causal progression. Can the model map out the steps of a recipe chronologically despite tight edits?

Format Description: Showing off a series of physical items, close-up details, and immediate hands-on impressions.
LLM Evaluation Target: Object recognition and attribute tracking (identifying brands, textures, colors, and relative sizes).

Format Description: Focus on ultra-high-quality micro-sounds (tapping, scraping, pouring) with close-up, repetitive, or satisfying physical actions.
LLM Evaluation Target: Audio-visual sync and sensory evaluation (linking the micro-interaction, like a brush touching a lens, to the corresponding audio spike).

Format Description: A split-screen video (side-by-side or picture-in-picture) where a creator reacts to or appends their own footage onto the end of someone else's.
LLM Evaluation Target: Understanding duality and split attention. Can the model separate "Video A" from "Video B" and explain the relationship (e.g., reaction, continuation, debunking)?

Format Description: Mimicking a highly specific, repeatable choreography or mouth movements synced to a popular trending sound.
LLM Evaluation Target: Action recognition and audio matching. Can the model verify if the actor's lips perfectly match the speed/lyrics of the trending track?

Format Description: A single creator playing multiple characters by changing hats, glasses, or camera angles to indicate a dialogue.
LLM Evaluation Target: Entity resolution. Can the model understand that the same physical actor is portraying two distinct characters based on visual props and spatial orientation?
